'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Brian Herold DS Kessel: Spice Mines - Administrator's Office''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel: Spice Mines - Administrator's Office]]
* '''Username:''' Jizzwailer's Wangzapper
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
